title: Pope Leo urges men to respect wives amid Latin American femicide crisis
paragraphs: Pope Leo urges men to respect wives amid Latin American femicide crisis

Pope Leo XIV urged men to respect their wives as he wrapped up the first leg of his 12-day tour of Latin America. The region recorded nearly 20,000 instances of women being killed over the past five years alone, most of them murdered by a current or former partner.
Pope Leo XIV told men to treat their wives with respect Sunday, as he concluded the first leg of his tour of Latin America, which is plagued by gender-based violence.
